# Y Combinator Jobs Scraper & API - Work at a Startup, YC Jobs

> Y Combinator jobs scraper and API for Work at a Startup, YC's job board: every open YC startup job searched live by title, role, place, batch, visa and pay, newest first.

## Summary

Y Combinator Jobs Search is an Apify actor that reads every open job at Y Combinator startups, as Work at a Startup (workatastartup.com) lists them and ycombinator.com shows them, at the moment of the run: it reads YC's company directory for every company that is hiring (1,500 on 2026-11-10), then each company's job list (6,316 jobs, against the 6,323 Work at a Startup counted that hour). Each row has the title, company, YC batch, places, remote or office, role, pay and equity as YC shows them and as numbers, visa terms, minimum years of experience, team size, company stage and industry, and the exact posting date from the job's own YC page, newest first. Unlike the other YC job actors, it dates every job to the second (YC's cards say only "about 1 month"), reads the whole board instead of 20 or 200 jobs, and filters by YC batch, visa sponsorship, minimum pay, equity, team size and stage. No login and no API key.

Store: https://apify.com/anshumanatrey/ycombinator-jobs-search
Source: https://github.com/AnshumanAtrey/ycombinator-jobs-search

## Key features

- Every open job of every hiring YC company, read live, newest first; 30 days by default (86% of YC's open jobs are older), any time for all.
- The exact posting date of every row, from each job's own YC page (datePosted); YC numbers jobs in posting order.
- YC's own filters: role and kind of engineering, YC batch (W25, Summer 2024, 2025), visa terms, minimum pay in US dollars, equity only, team size, company stage.
- Pay as YC shows it and as numbers with currency and period; equity as text and as percentages; visa terms on every row.
- Places by any name: cities, countries, regions (Europe, APAC), Worldwide, the Bay Area, SF, NYC; a place typed with the job title is read as the place.
- Checks pasted ycombinator.com and workatastartup.com job links: open, closed or not found.

## Input keys

- Job titles to find (searchTerms): one per line; a job matches when its title has every word; a place typed with the title is read as the place.
- Where the job is (location): cities, countries or regions; Remote alone asks for remote jobs, next to a city it changes nothing.
- Remote or office (workType): remote, hybrid or onsite.
- Posted in the last (postedWithin): 24 hours, 3, 7, 14 or 30 days (the default), any time, or your own period.
- Job role (role): engineering, design, product, science, sales, marketing, support, operations, recruiting, finance, legal, or backend, frontend, full-stack, machine-learning, ai-engineer, data-science, devops, mobile, hardware, robotics.
- Experience (experienceYears): your years, such as 3, 2-5, 5+ or fresher; keeps the jobs whose minimum is at or below them.
- YC batch (batch): W25, S24, F26, P25, Summer 2024, or a year such as 2025.
- Company stage (companyStage): early, growth or public.
- Team size (teamSize): 1-10, 11-50, 51-200, 201-1000, 1000+, or a range.
- Minimum pay, USD (minSalaryUsd): US dollars a year; hourly and monthly pay count as a year's.
- Only with equity (withEquity): keeps the jobs that show an equity range.
- Visa terms (visa): will-sponsor, not-required or us-only.
- Number of jobs (maxJobs): 100 by default, 0 for every match.
- Full details (includeDetails): adds the description as text and HTML, equity offered, and the city, state and country.
- Leave out words (excludeTerms): drops jobs whose title has these words.
- Job type (employmentType): full-time, contract or intern.
- Wider match (searchDescriptions): also keeps jobs whose description holds the words.
- Only these companies (companies): YC company names, company links or companySlug values.
- Job links to check (jobUrls): ycombinator.com or workatastartup.com job links.

## Pricing

- $0.00002 per job (Job event) on the Free and Starter plans; $0.000017 on Scale (SILVER); $0.000015 on Business (GOLD) and above
- $0.000025 per job with full details (Job with details event); $0.000021 on SILVER; $0.000018 on GOLD and above
- $0.005 per run start, per GB of memory ($0.005 at the default 1 GB), on every plan
- A checked link that is closed or not found is one Job event

Typical run, 100 newest jobs: about $0.007
Every open YC job (about 6,200): about $0.13
Apify's free $5 monthly credit covers about 71,000 jobs in runs of 100.

## When to use

- New jobs at YC startups by title, role, place, visa terms and pay, as a daily feed with exact posting times.
- Recruiting and sourcing: which YC companies hire for a role now, at what pay and equity, by batch and team size.
- Sales and investment research: hiring at YC companies as a signal, with batch, stage and team size.
- AI agents and data pipelines that need YC's jobs as clean JSON through the API or MCP.

## When NOT to use

- For YC's company directory itself (every company, hiring or not, with founders): use a YC directory actor.
- To apply to jobs: applying takes a YC account, through each row's applyUrl.

## Sample inputs

```json
{
  "searchTerms": ["software engineer"],
  "location": ["San Francisco"]
}
```

```json
{
  "role": ["engineering"],
  "batch": ["2025", "2026"],
  "visa": ["will-sponsor"],
  "minSalaryUsd": 150000,
  "postedWithin": "any time",
  "maxJobs": 50
}
```

## Sample output (one record)

```json
{
  "title": "Software Engineer, Data Platform",
  "company": "Preload",
  "location": "San Francisco, CA",
  "otherLocations": [],
  "workType": "onsite",
  "employmentType": "full-time",
  "department": "Engineering",
  "salary": "$150K - $225K",
  "postedAt": "2026-11-10T03:34:40Z",
  "jobUrl": "https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/preload/jobs/7hbolpR-software-engineer-data-platform",
  "status": "open",
  "platform": "ycombinator",
  "companySlug": "preload",
  "companyWebsite": "https://preload.ai",
  "jobId": "121721",
  "experienceMin": 2,
  "batch": "F26",
  "roleType": "Backend",
  "equity": "0.25% - 1.50%",
  "equityMin": 0.25,
  "equityMax": 1.5,
  "visa": "US citizenship/visa not required",
  "skills": ["Python", "Distributed Systems"],
  "companyOneLiner": "Sensorimotor context for physical AI",
  "teamSize": 3,
  "companyStage": "early",
  "industry": "B2B",
  "workAtAStartupUrl": "https://www.workatastartup.com/jobs/121721",
  "salaryMin": 150000,
  "salaryMax": 225000,
  "salaryCurrency": "USD",
  "salaryPeriod": "year"
}
```

## Differentiators vs alternatives

- vs nomad-agent/ycombinator-was-scraper (136 users in 30 days, $0.0001 a job): reads every job instead of at most 200 a run, dates each job from its YC page (its README sample is a month off the page), and filters by batch, visa, pay, equity, team size and stage; it costs less for runs under about 60 jobs and adds the description to every row.
- vs parsebird/yc-jobs-scraper ($0.00199 a job): about 100 times less per job, with the exact posting date and newest-first order.
- vs automation-lab/ycombinator-jobs-scraper: every open YC job instead of the 20 on ycombinator.com/jobs, with exact dates.
- vs memo23/y-combinator-scraper: every hiring company's jobs instead of YC's role and place pages; memo23 also reads the company directory.
